subject.title: feat(chat): migrate chat surface to Reactor

question: Should the default native chat surface move to the preview Microsoft.UI.Reactor implementation now, rather than remain an experimental or separately staged migration until its accessibility and scrolling behavior have stronger runtime proof?
rationale: This is a broad default-renderer replacement, not a narrow bug repair. The branch may be technically repairable, but choosing its rollout and dependency direction requires maintainer ownership beyond routine contributor follow-up.

options.title: Stage the migration with proof
options.body: Keep this PR in draft until scoped diagnostics and redacted current-head runtime proof demonstrate the native chat scenarios, then review the Reactor default migration as the proposed direction.

options.title: Keep Reactor experimental
options.body: Retain the existing FunctionalUI default and introduce Reactor behind an explicit experimental path until its virtualization and accessibility behavior has matured.

options.title: Defer the direction
options.body: Pause this branch and continue the narrower scrolling work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/issues/1054 before selecting a default renderer.

recommendation.title: Stage the migration with proof
recommendation.body: Keep this PR in draft until scoped diagnostics and redacted current-head runtime proof demonstrate the native chat scenarios, then review the Reactor default migration as the proposed direction.

likelyOwner.reason: The available review context identifies this contributor as the only concrete recent author across the affected Reactor migration surface; current-main feature-history ownership was not available in the supplied evidence.
